items.reason: Archived, superseded, or non-matchable canonical rows retained for provenance; complete or remove during catalog normalization.
Resolved September 30, 2026: the current Canine Cancer Alliance EGFR/HER2 status page identifies Hope Veterinary Oncology in Ventura as a participating location and does not mark it as non-enrolling.

The AMC hemangiosarcoma protocol page remains online, but the study is absent from AMC's current-studies master roster. Enrollment was not assumed closed; the record is hidden from matching pending direct confirmation.

A recent professional-network post says AURA Veterinary is recruiting dogs with oral cancer, but no official owner-facing protocol page, intervention, eligibility, sites, funding or enrollment contact could be verified. Do not create a canonical trial until a primary source is available.

The Anivive trial master and protocol URL returned HTTP 525 and the external web retriever could not open the cached page. A single technical failure is not sufficient to close the canonical trial, but current recruitment could not be independently reconfirmed in this run.

AMC currently lists the artificial neobladder study, but the same protocol has appeared in AMC materials since at least 2018. Do not expose it to matching until the study team directly confirms active enrollment in 2026.

Canine Cancer Alliance currently states that the Northwestern/Illinois B7-H3 CAR-T study is enrolling dogs with hemangiosarcoma, but its link resolves to an Illinois protocol PDF published in 2022/2023. Illinois' current clinical-trials master, checked September 30, 2026, does not list this protocol. Do not create a canonical record until the current treatment center page or Illinois clinical-trials manager Rebecca Kamerer confirms active 2026 enrollment and current protocol details.

BluePearl's current-studies roster still labels the canine splenic hemangiosarcoma Paccal Vet protocol as current, but the sponsor reported recruitment completed and positive topline results in September 2026. Keep the canonical record hidden until BluePearl confirms a new enrolling cohort or removes the stale listing.
